title: ESP32-simple_mqtt_lora: a simple LoRa to MQTT gateway
description: An ESP32 program that receives LoRa messages and publishes them to an MQTT broker over Wi-Fi. Written in C with ESP-IDF and FreeRTOS, in VS Code with PlatformIO, at the Universidade de Brasília with Prof. Jones Yudi Mori Alves da Silva.

contributors.name: Mori Alves da Silva, Jones Yudi
